content:
Last weekend, Apple TV made several announcements at San Diego Comic-Con, including the surprising reveal of the premiere date for the fourth season of *Silo*.

*Silo* season four will debut in the summer of 2027 and serve as the show's final season.

*Silo* season three is currently airing (watch it here), with new episodes releasing weekly through September 4.

However, at San Diego Comic-Con last weekend, alongside updates on its other sci-fi series, Apple also delivered a surprise announcement for *Silo* fans.

*Silo* season four will air next summer and bring the series to a close.

Below is the announcement post from Apple TV's X account:

In the streaming era, it's become commonplace for new seasons of shows to return after multi-year gaps — a trend that's especially true for higher-budget sci-fi productions like *Silo*.

That said, Apple has been accelerating the return of some of its series by greenlighting them well in advance. Seasons three and four of *Silo* were greenlit together and filmed back-to-back.

There are still six more weeks of new *Silo* episodes to enjoy, but once this season wraps up, fans won't have to wait long for season four.

What are your thoughts on *Silo* season three? Feel free to share in the comments.

Apple TV's monthly subscription is priced at US$12.99, with discount bundles available through Apple One.
